author: Bgdesiles
quote: A monumental disappointment.13 years of anticipation for an experience that feels increasingly disconnected from what made GTA great. The gameplay feels restrictive, missions overly scripted, and the criminal sandbox sacrificed for hand-holding and tedious activities. Worst of all, the Jason–Lucia couple dynamic feels forced and unwelcome, turning a crime saga into a relationship simulator filled with domestic chores, romance mechanics and unnecessary emotional management. Instead of letting players embrace the chaos, Rockstar seems determined to dictate how they should experience it. Spectacular graphics cannot compensate for uninspired design.
